text:
- **Search retrieval:** The new retrieval model ranks whole records and items by term frequency, with OR matching. Each hit now shows its best unit, with a header of match counts. The eval gate passed against the baseline. It failed against the rg and newest-first models. A delivery report and design pages were written.
- **Agent repo feedback:** Agents can now give feedback on the repo itself, using pm feedback add --repo. The feedback questions moved into the command help. The separate questions command was removed. Matching docs were updated.
- **Cross-repo PR reviews:** pm now raises, closes, and sprint-closes a review of another GitHub repo's pull request. The merge watcher stores that pull request's merge.
- **Project overview page:** The overview lists open projects first. Closed projects now sit in one collapsed section at the bottom.
